6. What is the compounds of the following structural formula? What are the types of hydrocarbons based on bond? Write
with reason.
Ans:- The name of compounds of the given saturated formula are propane and ethyne respectively.
Hydrocarbons are classified into different types on the basis of the type of bond present between
carbon atoms. Saturated hydrocarbons are those hydrocarbons in which carbon atoms are joined by
only single covalent bonds. Since all the valencies of carbon atoms are completely satisfied, they
are called saturated hydrocarbons. Unsaturated hydrocarbons are those hydrocarbons in which carbon atoms are joined by
one or more multiple bonds. They are called unsaturated because all the valencies of carbon atoms are not fully satisfied.
Unsaturated hydrocarbons are of two types. Alkenes are hydrocarbons that contain at least one double bond between carbon
atoms. Alkynes are hydrocarbons that contain at least one triple bond between carbon atoms.
